scripts.start: yarn build:games && yarn workspace site start
scripts.dev: yarn build:games && yarn workspace site dev
scripts.build: yarn build:games && yarn workspace site build
scripts.games: yarn build:games && yarn workspace site games
scripts.test: yarn workspaces foreach --all --include "lib/*" --include site --include "games/*" run test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && yarn workspaces foreach --all --include "lib/*" --include site --include "games/*" run typecheck
scripts.lint: yarn skills:check && yarn constraints && yarn dedupe --check && (cd .. && eslint -c frontend/eslint.config.js .agents frontend/tools frontend/yarn.config.cjs) && yarn workspaces foreach --all --include "lib/*" --include site --include "games/*" run lint && yarn prettier:check
scripts.verify: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn build
